scripts.build: npm run typecheck && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vite build
scripts.cf:types: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview:check: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.cache/wrangler WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply plan-shepherd-catalog --local
